tooltip.meharvest.me_harvest_flag.1: Harvests mature crops in range and replants them.
tooltip.meharvest.me_harvest_flag.2: Drops go straight into the ME network; seeds are pulled from it if needed.
tooltip.meharvest.me_harvest_flag.3: Runs on ME network power or FE cables; 10 kAE internal buffer.
tooltip.meharvest.me_harvest_flag.4: Handles multi-block and vine crops from Farmer's Delight and Kaleidoscope Cookery (rice, panicles, grapevines).
